title: KayKit Character Animations
creator: Kay Lousberg

download.acquisition: Creator-provided free download; no signup, payment, or third-party redistribution used. The transient download URL is intentionally not a runtime dependency.

derivedFiles.changes: Evaluate original TRS channels into semantic world positions and normalized world rotations at original sampler times. Explicit aliases represent absent intermediate bones; physical wrists and farther palm bones are distinct.
Source pose, temporal continuity, and contact proximity metrics; no target retargeting or gameplay changes.

limitations: No authored backward run or strafe walk in these free packs. Reversed Running_A, if used by the target, is a clearly identified derived adaptation.
Authored lateral runs intentionally cross the legs; target geometry clearance must be reviewed independently.
Source mannequin proportions and native sole penetration are not target anatomy or ground-contact requirements.

otherSourcesInspected.result: Forward run/walk references only; no authored backward or lateral clips. Not copied into this repository.
